mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which depresses near-term earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 3-year walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth prospects and triggers negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 212.5 over a 2-month window signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's predictive power is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals strong labor market tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock coupled with weakening labor demand, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling regression.
